Function: 1 A linear Li-ion charger (CC/CV to 4.2 V)
Battery protection: over-charge / over-discharge / over-current / short
Dual N-MOSFET switched by the DW01A
USB-C CC pull-downs (lets C-to-C chargers supply 5 V)
TP4056 PROG resistor: sets 1 A charge current
LED current limiting / DW01A current sense
